topic: Getting an eye exam and new glasses
passage: Last Saturday morning, I booked an eye exam because the words on my screen looked blurred. I arrived at the shop at nine and filled out a short form at the desk. A young doctor called my name and showed me into a quiet room. I sat down, took off my old glasses, and looked at a chart on the wall. She pointed out several letters I could not read clearly. Then she tried out different lenses and asked me to compare them. I picked out the pair that made the signs sharp again. She wrote down my new numbers and explained that I had worked too long at the computer. I paid at the front desk and waited for the frames I had chosen. After twenty minutes, the assistant handed me the new glasses. I put them on, walked outside, and looked around the street. The trees and shop signs seemed clearer than before. I called my wife and told her the news. In the evening, I turned down the screen brightness and promised to take more breaks. The visit took only one hour, but it cheered me up.

shadow_sentences.text: I arrived at the shop at nine in the morning.
The doctor asked me to look at a chart.
I put on my new glasses and walked outside.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录，主弱项继续是过去式 -ed 听辨和短语动词连读，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「去验光配新眼镜」是全新的健康话题，短文里有 booked/looked/arrived/filled/called/showed/pointed/tried/asked/picked/explained/worked/waited/handed/walked/seemed/turned/promised/cheered 等规则过去式；filled out、showed me into、sat down、took off、looked at、pointed out、tried out、picked out、wrote down、put them on、looked around、turned down、cheered me up 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
